name: Translation 即时翻译
description: Translation 即时翻译 —— 多引擎翻译插件，内置 9 类引擎：开箱即用的免费翻译服务、OpenAI 兼容大模型（DeepSeek、通义、智谱、Kimi、Ollama、vLLM 等）、本地 CLI 代理（claude / codex / 自定义）、DeepL、Google、百度、有道、阿里云、腾讯云；含流式输出、输入即译、引擎管理与翻译历史。

0.2.4：

2、引擎列表支持拖动排序

en.name: Translation
en.description: Translation — multi-engine translation plugin with 9 engine types: an out-of-the-box free translation engine (Bilibili's publicly deployed Index-Translate model, no signup and no API key), OpenAI-compatible LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, Kimi, Ollama, vLLM, …), local CLI proxies (claude / codex / custom), DeepL, Google, Baidu, Youdao, Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud; with streaming output, translate-as-you-type, engine management and translation history. All HTTP requests are issued by the bundled Go sidecar (the browser sandbox CSP forbids direct calls, and the host.network allowlist cannot express user-supplied endpoints); the sidecar connects directly to whatever HTTP/HTTPS endpoint the user configures per engine, and the source text is sent to the third-party service of the chosen engine. The local CLI engine executes user-configured local commands via an argument array (never through a shell); credentials stay with that CLI and are never touched by the plugin. When the built-in free engine is selected, your source text is likewise sent to that community endpoint (index-translate.bilibili.com); it is a shared service with no availability guarantee and no SLA, so choose one of your own engines if stability or data routing matters to you. API keys are encrypted with the OS keychain (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux secret-tool) before being written to the plugin data directory, falling back to machine-bound AES-256-GCM with an explicit in-UI warning. Engine config, history and preferences live in <plugin-data>/translation.db (SQLite), written by the sidecar; translation history (source and target text) is stored in plaintext and survives uninstallation, and can be cleared at any time from the History tab; the frontend runs in an opaque-origin sandbox and never touches disk or localStorage.
